title.description: When partOf is set, may be the literal string 'parent' to inherit the productGroup's title.

shortDescription.description: One-line summary for cards and feeds, so apps do not each truncate the long description differently.

acceptingOffers.description: The seller will consider offers. The price, if present, is a guide rather than a fixed ask.

availability.description: Availability status; can be computed from quantity or set independently. 'backorder' is out of stock but still orderable; 'pre_order' is not yet released.

manageStock.description: Whether the seller tracks inventory for this listing. When false, quantity is meaningless and should be ignored — this distinguishes untracked stock (print-on-demand, digital, services) from a quantity the seller simply did not fill in.

quantity.description: Available inventory count. Only meaningful when manageStock is true.

lowStockThreshold.description: Quantity at or below which the listing counts as low stock

soldIndividually.description: Only one of this item may be bought per order

subcategory.description: Free-text subcategory; vocabulary maintained outside the Lexicon

taxonomy.description: Optional deep category in an external taxonomy. Apps that do not use it fall back to the coarse category slug.

tags.description: Free-text discovery tags. Relieves pressure on the fixed category vocabulary — a seller whose niche has no slug tags it instead.

specifications.description: Properties that do not vary between variants (e.g. Material, Model). Machine-readable so apps can filter on them, unlike prose in the description.

sku.description: Seller-defined SKU for this variant. May be the literal string 'parent' to inherit the productGroup's SKU.

gtin.description: Global trade item number — GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN. The join key that lets two apps recognise the same product listed by different sellers.

shopRef.description: AT URI of the parent shop record

partOf.description: AT URI of the parent productGroup, if this listing is a variant

groupedItems.description: Other listings sold together as one offering (e.g. a desk setup of keyboard plus webcam). This listing states its own pricing, so no app has to compute a total from records held on other servers. Per-item discount rules are deliberately absent for that reason. Whether the buyer must take everything or may pick and choose is a checkout concern, not a schema one.

variantProperties.description: Concrete variant property tuple (e.g. [{axis: Color, value: Red}, {axis: Size, value: M}])

details.description: Type-specific fields matching the type discriminator

externalUrl.description: External URL for purchasing (e.g. Amazon, eBay link)

checkoutUrl.description: Direct checkout URL if supported by seller platform

location.description: Where this item is, when it differs from the shop's location — local pickup, or a seller with stock in more than one place. Falls back to the shop record.

taxStatus.description: Whether this item is taxed. Classification only — rate tables and tax calculation are out of scope.

taxCategory.description: Tax classification the seller's own rate table keys on. Open value set.

hideFromFriends.description: Social privacy: hide this listing from friends/followers

catalogVisibility.description: Where this listing surfaces. Distinct from hideFromFriends, which is social privacy: 'hidden' still resolves by direct link but is kept out of browse and search.

reviewsAllowed.description: Whether the seller accepts reviews on this listing

goodsDetails.description: Type-specific fields for physical goods. Describes what is being shipped, never what shipping costs — rates depend on the buyer's location and belong off-protocol.

shippingClass.description: Seller-defined shipping grouping (e.g. 'bulky', 'fragile') that their own rate table keys on

shippingRequired.description: Whether this item ships at all. Explicit rather than inferred from type, since services and digital goods can also be listed as goods.

serviceDetails.description: Type-specific fields for services and commissions

slotsAvailable.description: Number of service slots currently available

digitalDetails.description: Type-specific fields for digital goods. Download limits and expiry are terms of sale the buyer needs before purchase. The file itself is never published here — the record is public.

fileFormats.description: File formats included (e.g. PNG, SVG, AI). An asset pack is usually several.

downloadLimit.description: How many times the buyer may download. -1 for unlimited.

downloadExpiryDays.description: Days after purchase the download stays available. -1 for never expires.

deliveryMethod.description: How the digital good is delivered
